results.evidence: Observed dotnet test console result; the full run used console logging only and did not generate a TRX.

results.name: Focused host controls, exact MCP resource handles and Git settings
Final Web ceiling fix, all Web regressions, Shell and Git output guards

coverage: Trusted outer execution_context is independent of model-authored params and isolated across concurrent calls
Missing raw parameters use frozen defaults; explicit values remain explicit and are bounded by configured ceilings
Selected package roots are readable and do not become writable; ancestor links outside a package are refused
MCP exact resource identity, environment/configuration fingerprints, immutable run leases and active-call cleanup
Host controls remain approval-free and excluded from the model manifest
Per-Git operation output budgets and actual log paging defaults
Explicit Web parameters cannot exceed frozen byte/text caps and late responses cannot defeat elapsed timeouts
limitations: The final Web ceiling fix was covered by its focused54-test regression; the full389-test suite was not repeated after that small fix.
MCP tests use actual local Node.js stdio fixture processes, not external production integrations.
Optional ripgrep/link/OS tests retain the repository's prerequisite guards; a pass count alone does not prove every optional mechanism was exercised.
